newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT to take part in Pacific cable network - paper.
newsitem.headline: NTT to take part in Pacific cable network - paper.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) will join AT & T Corp and Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) in laying an undersea optical cable network linking the United States, Japan and China by 2000, a Japanese business daily reported on Tuesday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said that the partners were expected to sign an agreement on the 100 billion yen project on March 30.

The paper said that part ownership of the network would put NTT on an equal footing with KDD, Japan's largest international telecoms company, when NTT gets its expected approval to offer international telecoms services as early as 1999.
An NTT spokesman said on Tuesday morning that the company had no immediate official comment on the report.
